newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU antitrust experts call for ban of Boeing merger.
newsitem.headline: EU antitrust experts call for ban of Boeing merger.

text.p: A meeting of antitrust experts from the 15 European Union states recommended unanimously on Wednesday banning the $14 billion merger between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp, an industry source said.

The source was reading from the official opinion agreed by the experts. The European Commission is widely expected to follow the advice at its regular meeting next week after Boeing, the U.S. aircraft giant, failed to address its concerns that the deal would harm fair competition in the Union.
"The advisory committee again unanimously supported the Commission view that the remedies offered were unsufficient," the source told Reuters, speaking on the condition of anonymity.
The Commission was not immediately available to comment. but it is widely expected to block the merger at its regular meeting next Wednesday.
A majority in the committee was of the opinion that Boeing's proposals to avoid that defence contracts money 'spill-over' to commercial aviation programmes "showed progress", the source said.

German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Wednesday that Boeing had offered to report regularly to the EU on any cross-subsidies from McDonnell-Douglas' military business to its own civilian operations. Rexrodt added this and other commitmemts were not enough to win EU approval. -- Brussels Newsroom 32 2 287 6800
